annotations.title: Find doctors for a procedure near a place

description: This tool finds doctors with public records for a procedure near a US city or ZIP code, such as a knee replacement surgeon near me. It returns up to 5 doctors, ordered by nearest office first. Each doctor includes distance, Medicare yearly procedure count, and CMS-listed affiliated hospitals. For procedures with hospital results, each hospital is better than, no different from, or worse than the national rate. OpenHealth does not grade or rank doctors. The better_hospital_only filter keeps doctors with a better hospital. The radius is 10, 25 or 50 miles. These Medicare records are incomplete.

better_hospital_only.description: When true, the tool lists only doctors affiliated with at least one hospital whose result is better than the national rate. The default is false.

place.description: A US city with its state, such as Columbus, OH, or a 5-digit ZIP code.

procedure.description: The procedure, as an id such as knee-replacement or in plain words such as knee replacement.

radius_miles.description: The search radius in miles: 10, 25 or 50. The default is 25.
